notes.subject: Kristy call notes — 2026 outreach
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes list McCone County Fair in Circle, Montana, 406-939-3889, and say called June 3/left message. Gmail history from 2025 gives a better contact path: the Circle Chamber directed Adventure Zone to Tandi Kassner at 406-485-2605 / tandi.kassner@montana.edu. Source: handwritten call notes page 85; Adventure Zone Gmail.
